uncited: The Affine Grid Generator produces a transformed coordinate grid by applying an affine transformation to a base grid of normalized coordinates.
It solves the problem of spatially warping input data (such as images or voxel grids) for tasks like spatial transformer networks or deformable voxelization.

It differs from its sibling [3D Coordinate Grid Generation](2333-3d-coordinate-grid-generation.md) by explicitly applying a learnable or provided affine matrix $\theta$ to the coordinates, whereas the sibling generates static normalized grids.
It differs from [CT Slice Voxel Construction](8351-ct-slice-voxel-construction.md) by operating on continuous coordinate spaces rather than discrete voxel indices derived from projection geometry.
Each matrix maps homogeneous 3D coordinates to 3D coordinates.
